scope: Actual retained native route and separately identified existing alternatives. Owner records do not implement/inject upstream code.

recombination_closure_choices.required_ownership: Case-A recombination plus explicitly transported diffuse photon source, primary absorption, spectrum/multiplicity and consistent gas binding/thermal ledger
FT03 Case-A RR/DR energy escape once; no diffuse photon inventory or reabsorption
Case-B rates with consistent local absorption/thermal convention; no duplicate full Case-A sink, extra diffuse source or escape energy

rows.process: prescribed LRS geometry, proper epoch and nuclear density
rows.inputs: elapsed proper seconds in [0,1e11]; selected z_a=5.807 origin
rows.single_owner_rule: One time map and proper-density conversion; ln(a) is not seconds.

rows.inputs: author UVB J_nu at initial E=q and z_a=5.807
rows.single_owner_rule: Use UVB only for t=0; do not impose later UVB/PI-rate tables on evolving photons.
Emission is injected once; no c factor and no invented additional escape fraction.

rows.process: H/He RR, electron-impact ionization, HeII two-term DR and energy moments
rows.owner: rei_bianchi FT03 family; BASS_HE role is atomic/source semantics
rows.inputs: same-stage gas T, ne and proper nuclear species densities
rows.outputs: cm^-3 s^-1 events; erg cm^-3 s^-1 thermal and escape terms
rows.single_owner_rule: Native thermo photon state is zero; custom evolving-node PI owns photon events. Raw Grackle functions are a different path.

rows.owner: BASS_HE atomic-data/domain contract; existing rei AtomicProvider evaluator
rows.inputs: gas-frame energy in eV and absorber species
rows.outputs: sigma in cm^2 with three independent fit cutoffs
rows.single_owner_rule: Sigma has no density/time/radiation normalization. Fit cutoffs are not binding energies.

rows.process: photon loss, ionization, binding and primary photoheat
rows.inputs: proper lower-state populations, evolving weighted photon nodes, sigma, c, binding chi
rows.outputs: event=c*sigma*n_gamma*n_abs; Gamma; photon loss; ion/electron source; chi binding; (E-chi) heat
rows.single_owner_rule: Exactly one event owns all four ledgers. Do not add homogeneous_photo_rates or a second primary-stage sink on top.

rows.inputs: Case-A RR kinetic and binding energy; two DR captured-energy moments
rows.outputs: escaped energy in erg cm^-3 s^-1
rows.single_owner_rule: No photon count or spectrum is inferred from scalar recombination/escape energy. Choose one of the upstream closure alternatives before switching.

rows.process: gas expansion work in retained native route
rows.inputs: H and proper thermal energy, local species/electron source
rows.outputs: u_dot=-5*H*u+local_power; corresponding T and w evolution
rows.single_owner_rule: No separate outer -2H*T term. If using coupled_primary instead, its existing thermal-work owner replaces this owner.

rows.process: directional characteristic and photon redshift/shear work
rows.single_owner_rule: One characteristic/Jacobian mapping; fixed-q photon state is not redshifted a second time by moment accounting.
rows.support_policy: finite initial q=10..50000 eV; no excluded-q boundary inflow

rows.process: existing primary-only evaluator and opacity-owner decomposition
rows.inputs: proper absorber cm^-3; bin-integrated comoving cMpc^-3 photons; mean scale factor
rows.outputs: Gamma,event,primary heat,binding,comoving photon-loss and species opacity fractions
rows.single_owner_rule: An alternate adapter or comparator; never add its sink/heat to the already counted native/primary event.

rows.outputs: implicit gas, positive photon state, event and energy ledger
rows.single_owner_rule: Preserve its existing gas-work owner; chosen source/rate/domain injection must cover both point and root/interval routes.
rows.current_atomic_path: Ft03Model::controlled -> ft03_rhs; signatures -> AtomicProvider::reference cross sections

rows.owner: BASS_HE selected rate packet; rei opt-in RCT adapter
rows.inputs: one explicit KF96 or GM25 source, common-T Maxwell zero-drift W82 ground-state scenario, proper HI and HeIII
rows.outputs: k nHI nHeIII events, species [-1,+1,0,+1,-1,0], direct delta ne=0, one event photon under stated scenario
rows.single_owner_rule: Alternative rates are never additive or averaged; source conflict acknowledgment is not physical admission.

rows.process: optional RCT escaping mean photon energy and thermal split
rows.owner: caller-defined research closure; rei RCT adapter
rows.inputs: positive caller-supplied mean escaped photon energy mu; chosen k and gas model chi
rows.single_owner_rule: No physical energy moment is predicted by a count rate. combined_ft03_rhs preserves FT03 thermo; do not call combined_hhe_rhs on Ft03Model.gas whose generic coefficients are zero.

rows.process: 584 Angstrom, 2^1P<->2^1S, 2^1S two-photon and excited bound-free spectral source
rows.inputs: separately selected differential emission model and excited-state population/source contract
rows.outputs: potential emitted spectrum/multiplicity/moments; not supplied by selected warm baseline
rows.single_owner_rule: Do not reinterpret MICRO-0 ground-state rate or a total transition rate as an unresolved differential spectrum. This optional lane does not block the selected warm baseline.
rows.retained_source_branch: D86_TABLE_V_LENGTH_LINEAR_B (historical T0 authority; no source amendment in this work unit)

rows.process: raw rate/cooling expressions and branch/floor/cap parity
rows.outputs: source raw coefficient with explicit density prefactor, units and species-change metadata
rows.single_owner_rule: Implementation guard is not physical temperature support or thermal closure; current warm stage still calls FT03.

rows.process: HH reactions and hard-particle CR/secondary deposition
rows.inputs: requires a future named reaction/source/domain and closure
rows.outputs: no contribution in selected warm primary-only model
rows.single_owner_rule: Reusing photon-absorption/heat tools does not enable hard-particle CR. HH/RCT/CR OFF is this baseline choice, not a restriction on independent research.

global_rules.same_absorber_effective_MFP_and_local_op: one owner; a disjoint-population decomposition requires an explicit photon/energy attribution
